cues.en: Welcome to this section of the course, which is all about algebra.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到代數章節。

cues.en: I'm going to start this section with probably the most fundamental and most important part of algebra, which is solving for x.
cues.zh: 先從代數最基礎、最重要的部分開始，也就是解出 x。

cues.en: So I will show you how to use sympy to solve for a variable, a symbolic variable, and you'll also get to learn a little bit about Python lists.
cues.zh: 會示範用 SymPy 解符號變數，也會多介紹一點 Python 串列。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what does it mean to solve for x?
cues.zh: 解出 x 是什麼意思？

cues.en: So if you see this expression: four X equals two, then we might wonder what is x equals to?
cues.zh: 看到 4x=2，可能會問，x 等於多少？

cues.en: So to solve for x you have to isolate X on one side of the equation by doing all sorts of arithmetic operations.
cues.zh: 要解出 x，就透過各種算術運算，把 x 單獨留在等式的一邊。

cues.en: So in this case you can divide both sides by four and then you get X equals one half.
cues.zh: 這裡兩邊都除以 4，得到 x 等於二分之一。

cues.en: Now if you have multiple variables in the equation, you might have something like this: minus four x squared equals Y to the one third power.
cues.zh: 如果式子有多個變數，例如 -4x 平方，等於 y 的三分之一次方，

cues.en: Then you can still solve for x and that solution is going to be in context of y, or Y is going to be in the solution of x.
cues.zh: 仍能解出 x，只是解會以 y 表示，也就是 y 會出現在 x 的解裡。

cues.en: So we are defining X in part by the value of y.
cues.zh: 因此，x 的定義部分取決於 y。

cues.en: So for this expression, the value of x turns out to be plus or minus two times the square root of minus one which is a bizarre looking operation.
cues.zh: 這個式子，x 的值是正負 2（畫面註記更正：應為 1/2）乘以根號 -1，這個運算看起來很奇怪。

cues.en: This is actually something called a imaginary operator. It's how we form complex numbers.
cues.zh: 它其實叫做虛數單位，用來形成複數。

cues.en: And I will talk about complex numbers later on in the course.
cues.zh: 複數會在後面介紹。

cues.en: Times Y to the 1 6th.
cues.zh: 再乘以 y 的六分之一次方。

cues.en: Now you could also turn this equation around and set it equal to y.
cues.zh: 也能反過來，解出 y。

cues.en: And in this case that's actually not so difficult because Y is already on its own on one side of the equation.
cues.zh: 這次其實不難，因為 y 已經單獨在等式一側，

cues.en: We would just have to raise both sides of this equation to the power of three to isolate y on this side.
cues.zh: 只要把兩邊都取 3 次方，就能讓 y 單獨留在這邊。

cues.en: The last thing that I want to mention before switching to Python is a little bit of terminology in algebra.
cues.zh: 切換到 Python 前，最後介紹一點代數術語。

cues.en: So you can have an expression like this where you have something on the left hand side of the equation and something on the right hand side of the equation if you would move everything onto one side of the
cues.zh: 像這個等式，左邊有些東西，右邊也有些東西。如果把全部移到同一，

cues.en: equation then you're setting the equation equal to zero.
cues.zh: 邊，就能讓另一邊等於 0。

cues.en: This is often called a homogenous form.
cues.zh: 通常稱為 homogeneous form，齊次形式。

cues.en: So this equation is in it's homogenous form.
cues.zh: 這就是等式的齊次形式。

cues.en: Notice I've just moved the nine to the left.
cues.zh: 注意，我只是把 9 移到左邊，

cues.en: Put a minus sign on it of course and then set the whole equation to zero.
cues.zh: 當然要加負號，再讓整個式子等於 0。

cues.en: Now the reason why I'm mentioning this is because in many sympy functions, the way to operate the function,
cues.zh: 提到這點，是因為很多 SymPy 函數的，

cues.en: the way to use the function, is not by inputting an equation but by setting the equation to zero.
cues.zh: 使用方式，不是直接輸入等式，而是先讓式子等於 0，

cues.en: And then you input just the non-zero side of the equation.
cues.zh: 再只輸入非零的那一邊。

cues.en: So the homogenous form of the equation, you've already seen that a little bit in the previous section with providing one input into the eq or equals function.
cues.zh: 前一章 Eq 函數只提供一個輸入時，就稍微看過這種齊次形式。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。
